Senior Full Stack Engineer
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and MongoDB. You will architect real-time event streaming systems and lead code reviews.
Requirements:
- 5+ years with React and TypeScript (must)
- Strong Node.js and MongoDB backend experience (must)
- Experience with GraphQL APIs and Docker (nice)
- Proven mentorship and cross-functional team leadership (must)

Backend Infrastructure Engineer
Requirements:
- Distributed systems and high-throughput microservices (must)
- Kafka and Redis clustering (must)
- Golang or Java proficiency (must)
- Kubernetes deployment pipelines (nice)

Lead Frontend Architect
Requirements:
- Deep React internals, Next.js App Router, and SSR (must)
- Web performance optimization, Core Web Vitals (must)
- Accessible UI design system development (must)
- Testing with Jest and Playwright (nice)
